The Guideline Value and Market Value of Government lands are required for various purposes such as transfer, alienation, lease, assignment etc. The market value of private lands is also sought by requisitioning agencies such as various State/Central Public Sector Undertakings, Central Government Departments etc., which intend to purchase such private lands directly. Among other issues, the Commissioner of Land Administration has suggested the following procedure for fixing the Guideline Value:-

2

Violence adversely affects women’s physical, sexual and reproductive, and mental health in domestic environment, public places and Institutions. Intimate partner violence and sexual violence can lead to unintended pregnancies, induced abortions (often conducted in unsafe conditions), and sexually transmitted infections, including HIV. extracts.text:
The Information and Public Relations Department with its different wings executes work propagating the Hon’ble Chief Minister’s successful and tireless works which involve detailed planning and sharp execution, the policies of the Government and awareness information.

4

PRESS RELEASE SECTION

The Press Release Section works on all days disseminating information among the public on the announcements made by Hon’ble Chief Minister, press notes and press releases.

Press Notes of the Hon’ble Chief Minister and Hon’ble Ministers; Press Releases, Announcements, Welfare Schemes, Developmental works and details of achievements, news relating to Government functions, all news on the events relating to Government, video recordings and related photos are sent to more than 325 print and visual media such as dailies, news agencies, periodicals, and television channels through the Press Release Section through email and are also posted in website, then and there, to ensure the news reaches the general public.

Press Release section makes necessary arrangements for organizing Press Meets for the Hon’ble Chief Minister and the Hon’ble Ministers. This Section also extends all assistance to media personnel to attend and gather news in

5

Government functions participated by Hon’ble Ministers, Secretaries to Government, and also on the arrivals of VVIPs.

Government Announcements, Important Press Releases and News about important events taking place at the Head Quarters, video clips of video conferencing and photos are uploaded immediately using modern technology in the website of the Information and Public Relations Department www.dipr.tn.gov.in for the use of media and the same are sent through e-mail to the District PROs of all Districts to get them published at the district level also.

Besides arranging publication of news and photos of important Government functions and events held in districts participated by the Hon’ble Chief Minister and Hon’ble Ministers in the concerned districts, the news and photos are also obtained at the headquarters from the District Collectors and this section distributes them to all newspapers published from Chennai, All India Radio for broadcasting and to TV channels for telecasting.

6

JOURNALISTS WELFARE JOURNALISTS PENSION

The Government is giving monthly Pension to Journalists who are working round the clock to spend their post-retirement life peacefully. Monthly pension is given to indigent journalists who have retired after putting in twenty years of service.

Presently, a monthly pension of Rupees Ten Thousand is being paid to 232 journalists through banks.

In order to enable more number of Journalists to benefit from this scheme, the gratuity ceiling for eligibility to pension is fixed at Rupees Three Lakh and the ceiling of annual income of Journalists while in service is fixed at Rupees Three Lakh.
